definitionUrl.description: Absolute URL of this definition's OpenAPI document.

documentationUrl.description: Absolute URL of the human-readable reference.

operations.description: Every operation the definition serves, each with its method, path, permission, filters, paging, fields, and whether this credential may call it. A route that serves a retired entity's row in place of a live one names that row's fields in retiredFields, which is null on every other route. Embedded rather than served separately: an operation has no identity apart from the definition it belongs to.

preferred.description: True for the version a new integration should build against.

releaseId.description: The release this pack currently publishes: the ccr_factory commit it was built from. Null while a stage's mirror has not moved to release folders.

title.description: The pack's display name in the CCR catalogue, such as AWS S3. Null when the catalogue names none.

description.description: The control statement the rule checks, which may carry HTML links.

files.description: Each file as `<controlId>/<path>`, its path inside the pack's source zip.

matchers.description: One item per matcher the manifest lists, such as `cloud` or `terraform`, carrying its name, whether it is implemented, its files and the resource types it targets, and, when unimplemented, the author's note. A matcher's `files` are its file under each mode the rule ships, as `<controlId>/<path>` paths inside the pack's source zip, whatever the request's filters keep.

modes.description: The modes the rule ships, such as `allowlist`. ccr_factory owns the values.

controlId.description: The framework's control, not a TrustOnCloud control identifier.

requestId.description: Quote this when reporting a problem.

id.description: The key id, the public half of the credential.

permissions.description: What this credential may call, sorted.

kind.description: `service` for a key that acts for itself, whose id is the key id; `user` for a key that acts for a person, whose id is that person's.

tenantId.description: The credential's tenant. Never the subject.

OverwatchUpdatesRow.description: A live entity's row, or a retired entity's row in its place. `retired` tells them apart.

actionIds.description: Action ids from the export's `threatmodel_change_ids`. Null on a redacted row.

controlIds.description: Control ids from the export's `threatmodel_change_ids`. Null on a redacted row.

controlObjectiveIds.description: Control objective ids from the export's `threatmodel_change_ids`. Null on a redacted row.

entitled.description: True when your subscriptions include OverWatch for this update's ThreatModel. False on a redacted row, whose analysis properties are null.

featureClassIds.description: Feature class ids from the export's `threatmodel_change_ids`. Null on a redacted row.

number.description: The U-number, the integer after `U` in `overwatchId`. Assigned once and never reused, so within a provider it only grows.

overwatchId.description: `Overwatch.{Provider}.U{number}`, the id the OverWatch email and export carry.

provider.description: The provider whose catalogue publishes the update, such as `aws`.

providerUpdates.description: The provider announcements the update was raised from. Present on a redacted row.

publishedAt.description: When OverWatch first published the update, in UTC. Within a provider it never falls as `number` rises.

securityLevel.description: TrustOnCloud's level for the update, such as `High`. Null on a redacted row.

services.description: The provider's services the update concerns, as OverWatch names them, such as `s3`. Not ThreatModel ids.

threatIds.description: Threat ids from the export's `threatmodel_change_ids`. Null on a redacted row.

threatmodelChange.description: What the update changes in the ThreatModel, as prose. Null on a redacted row.

tmId.description: The ThreatModel the analysis concerns, empty when there is none. Null on a redacted row.

oneOf.description: A retired update keeps its place in the ordering, by the date it was published, and carries only these properties. It has no service or security level, so a page filtered by either, or by `since`, leaves it out.

publishedAt.description: When OverWatch first published the update, in UTC. Within a provider it never falls as `number` rises.

Page.description: The collection envelope. A route with a declared projection narrows `items` to its own row schema.

nextCursor.description: Absent as null on the last page. No total count is served.

assuredBy.description: A comma-separated string, published as it is rather than split into an array.

dependsOn.description: A comma-separated string, published as it is rather than split into an array.

effort.description: One of Very High, High, Medium, Low.

featureClassIds.description: Feature class IDs. Threats and actions carry one feature class ID.

mitigate.description: Objects carrying threat, impact, priority, maxDependency, priorityOverall and cvss, where cvss is a severity enum from Very High to Very Low.

weightedPriority.description: One of Very High, High, Medium, Low.

oneOf.description: A retired entity keeps its place in the ordering and carries only these properties. It has no feature class, so it appears only on an unfiltered page.

ThreatmodelsProviderServiceThreatsRow.description: A live entity's row, or a retired entity's row in its place. `retired` tells them apart.

access.description: A nested boolean expression over permissions, with the keys AND, OR, OPTIONAL and UNIQUE. Not an access level.

cvss.description: A CVSS vector string. A control's mitigate[].cvss is a severity enum instead.

featureClassId.description: One feature class ID. Controls carry an array of feature class IDs.

mitreAttack.description: One MITRE ATT&CK tactic id, such as TA0040. Not a list of mappings.

apiKey.description: An API key, in `Authorization: Bearer`. Never a query parameter: that writes the credential into access logs.

parameters.description: Which archive to serve. `source` is the rule tree (`bundle.zip`) a reviewer reads, one folder per control. `deploy` is the Terraform package (`deploy.zip`) a customer applies.
parameters.name: kind

parameters.description: Pins the download to this release id, the `release_id` the pack's manifest names. A release that is no longer current answers 410 `release_superseded`. Absent serves the current release.
parameters.name: release

parameters.description: Only rules whose control id matches this pattern, ignoring case, such as `S3.C100` or `S3.C1*`. `*` matches any run of characters and `?` exactly one; nothing else is special. Repeat it to match any of several values, up to 20, each at most 200 characters. Absent or empty applies no filter.
parameters.name: control

parameters.description: Only rules that ship this mode, ignoring case. The modes are the pack format's, such as `allowlist` and `universal` today. A file under another mode's folder is left out of the zip. Repeat it to match any of several values, up to 20, each at most 200 characters. Absent or empty applies no filter.
parameters.name: mode

parameters.description: Only rules that implement this matcher, ignoring case. The matchers are the pack format's, such as `cloud` and `terraform` today. A file under another matcher's folder, `<mode>/<matcher>/`, is left out of the zip, while the rest of a mode's files and the rule's root files are kept. Repeat it to match any of several values, up to 20, each at most 200 characters. Absent or empty applies no filter.
parameters.name: matcher

parameters.description: Only files whose path in the zip, `<controlId>/<path>`, matches this pattern, case-sensitively, such as `*/terraform/*.rego`. `*` matches any run of characters, `/` included, and `?` exactly one. Repeat it to match any of several values, up to 20, each at most 200 characters. Absent or empty applies no filter.
parameters.name: file

200.description: Without a rule filter, the pack's archive as published, checked against its manifest's digest before it is served. With one, a zip of exactly the files `/v1/ccr/packs/{tmId}/rules` lists for the same filters, each entry copied unchanged from that checked source archive, so one selection of one release is always the same bytes.

Content-Digest.description: On a selection alone, the SHA-256 of the body as RFC 9530 spells it, `sha-256=:<base64>:`, since no manifest publishes a digest for a part of a pack. The whole archive's is the `sha256` its manifest publishes.

Content-Disposition.description: `attachment`, with the name to save it under: `<tmId>_wiz-ccr-source_<release>.zip` for the source archive, `<release>` being the first 7 characters of its release id, and `<tmId>.zip` for the deploy package. A selection adds `_selection-` and the first 12 hex digits of its SHA-256 before `.zip`, so it is never saved under the whole pack's name, and two selections are named apart.

400.description: A filter value outside its allowed set, a filter given more values, or a longer value, than it accepts, or a parameter this operation does not accept. `control`, `mode`, `matcher`, and `file` are refused the same way until your tenant has them. A rule filter given with `kind=deploy` is refused, since the deploy package's folders are not mapped to rules.

401.description: No credential was presented, or it did not resolve to a known key.

403.description: `ip_not_allowed`: The credential is valid and the source address is not in the tenant's allowed ranges. `forbidden`: The credential was not granted the permission this operation requires.

404.description: No such resource, or one this tenant is not entitled to. The two are deliberately indistinguishable: naming which would tell an unentitled caller that the resource exists. A selection that keeps no file is answered with this, rather than an empty zip.

410.description: The release named in `release` is no longer the one this resource publishes: it was replaced, or withdrawn by a rollback. Read the resource again without `release` to learn the current one.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after the interval given in the Retry-After header.

500.description: A failure on our side that retrying will not fix: an unhandled error, or data this API could not read. Quote the requestId in the body when reporting it.

503.description: Authentication or a dependency is unavailable. This is ours rather than the caller's and is safe to retry; a valid credential is not invalidated by it. Two refusals with this status are the exception, and retrying either will not help until the pack is republished: an archive that does not match the digest its manifest publishes, and a source archive a selection cannot copy entry by entry.

404.description: No such resource, or one this tenant is not entitled to. The two are deliberately indistinguishable: naming which would tell an unentitled caller that the resource exists.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after the interval given in the Retry-After header.

500.description: A failure on our side that retrying will not fix: an unhandled error, or data this API could not read. Quote the requestId in the body when reporting it.

503.description: Authentication or a dependency is unavailable. This is ours rather than the caller's and is safe to retry; a valid credential is not invalidated by it.

parameters.description: Only rows in the feature class with this ID, such as `S3.FC1`, matched exactly. A control matches when any of its feature class IDs is this one. Empty or absent applies no filter.
parameters.name: featureClassId

parameters.description: The release to read, by its `version` key, such as `1611187200`. Absent reads the latest. A release this ThreatModel does not publish answers 404 `not_found`, and an empty value is refused.
parameters.name: release

parameters.description: Defaults to 100, capped at 500.
parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.description: An opaque cursor from a previous page's `nextCursor`. Bound to the tenant, the route, the filter arguments and the credential, so it is not valid on another collection or for another caller.
parameters.name: cursor

400.description: A malformed `pageSize`, a cursor not valid for this request, or a parameter this operation does not accept.
